summary: openghg_inversions . A Python package that is being developed as part of the OpenGHG project with the aim of merging the data-processing and simulation modelling capabilities of OpenGHG with the atmospheric Bayesian inverse models developed by the Atmospheric Chemistry Research Group at the University of Bristol. .
